description: Choose a Canva design, PDF/text file, LinkedIn export or GitHub repositories, then review before saving.
file: PDF, text or LinkedIn CSV files

fileDropTitle: Drag files here or browse from your device
fileDropReplace: Click or drag to choose different files
reviewNote: Automatic field mapping can make mistakes. Uncertain dates and employers stay blank for you to correct in the next steps. Existing resumes are unchanged at this stage.

canvaSourceHint: Sign in with Canva, pick your design and import it.
